directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the saying " The best preparation for tomorrow is doing your best today. " You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the saying " The best preparation for tomorrow is doing your best today. " You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
outline: 第 1 段｜转述格言并亮明立场：首段先复述格言含义，点出它讲的是当下与未来的因果，然后一句话亮出赞同态度，即中心论点，为全文定调。
第 2 段｜原理加正反例论证中心：主体段承担论证：先说清今天努力转化为明天准备的原理，再用备考的正反对比和职业成长的例子落地，把抽象格言变成具体画面。
第 3 段｜重申立场并发出行动号召：尾段回扣格言、重申立场，把结论升华为对读者的启示与号召——把握今天，让明天自然到来，做到首尾照应。
points: 原理：今天的积累转化为明天的底气：第一条要点讲清因果原理——每天的努力会一点点沉淀成知识与能力，等机会来临时便成了现成的准备。这条负责论证格言『为什么成立』，把 The best preparation for tomorrow is doing your best today. 的逻辑说透。
例证：备考与职业成长的对比：第二条要点落到具体场景：以备考为例，每天复习的人在考试日收获回报，临时抱佛脚拖延的人则慌乱失利；再延伸到职业成长，日常打磨的技能悄悄为未来机会铺路。用正反对比让『今天努力如何变成明天准备』看得见、摸得着。
启示：把握当下、付诸行动：第三条要点收束升华：既然未来握在今天手里，就该停止焦虑、抓住当下能掌控的事，给读者一个行动号召，回扣格言、首尾照应。
facts: 核心任务｜评论一句关于当下与未来的格言：本题要写一篇评论格言的议论文，格言是 The best preparation for tomorrow is doing your best today.。把它拆成因果两半：『今天全力以赴』是因，『为明天做最好的准备』是果。任务的核心不是泛谈努力，而是讲清『今天的行动如何决定明天』这条因果链，并亮出你赞同的态度。
读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式书面议论：本题没有指定收信人或身份，属于纯议论大作文，只需面向阅卷人用正式书面语即可：不用口语缩略、不用第二人称说教式的 you，多用 we/us 把读者一起带入，语气客观、论证清楚。这是六级大作文的默认语域，不必强行加应用文的称呼或落款。
中心立意｜今天全力以赴即最好的准备：本篇中心论点：与其焦虑地空想未来，不如把今天的事做到最好，因为当下的踏实努力才是通向明天的最可靠准备。这一句直接呼应 doing your best today，把格言的因果关系表态为赞同立场。
rubric: 内容切题｜紧扣今天与明天的因果：本题达标要点是全程扣住 The best preparation for tomorrow is doing your best today. 的因果，例子必须能说明今天的行动如何变成明天的准备；最易失分处是只谈『努力可贵』却不接『为明天做准备』，导致偏离格言主旨。
结构连贯｜三段分明加逻辑词串联：本题要三段清楚，首段表态、主体论证、尾段号召；本范文用 In contrast 做正反对比、The same logic applies 做延伸、Therefore 收尾，正反因果一目了然。易失分处是通篇不分段或论点论据脱节。
语言准确｜用主题地道表达替口水话：本题宜用 seize the day、lay a solid foundation、pay off、procrastination 等切题表达提升准确与地道度；最易失分处是中式英语逐字直译（如把『打下基础』写成 dozy the base）和时态混乱。
字数格式｜卡准词数区间与议论文格式：本题要求 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，低于下限或超过上限都扣分，须匀速控字、留检查时间；格式上是纯议论文，无须称呼与署名，只要三段清晰即可。
pitfalls: 通篇复述格言喊口号：反面示例："Doing your best today is very important. It is the best preparation. Everyone should do their best today because tomorrow needs today." 这只是把格言换词复述、内容空洞。改成："Take exam preparation as an example: a student who reviews a little every day gradually accumulates the knowledge that pays off on the test day." 用具体场景让因果落地。

只讲努力不扣为明天做准备：反面示例："Hard work is a good virtue. Diligent people are admired by everyone and hard work makes us better." 只谈努力、完全没接『为明天做准备』的因果。改成："The effort we make today is not wasted; it quietly prepares us for opportunities that will arrive tomorrow." 把今天和明天接上。

同义反复注水凑字：反面示例："Today is important. Today matters a lot. The present day is really important for us." 三句一个意思，纯注水。改成："Today matters because the small efforts we make now accumulate into real ability over time." 一句带出新信息、给出理由。
model: The saying "The best preparation for tomorrow is doing your best today" reminds us of a simple yet profound truth: our future is not built by anxious planning alone, but by the concrete effort we invest at this very moment. In my view, giving our best today is precisely how we lay a solid foundation for a brighter tomorrow.

This idea holds true in almost every field. Take exam preparation as an example. A student who reviews a little every day, solving problems and memorizing words, gradually accumulates the knowledge that pays off on the test day. In contrast, those who indulge in procrastination and cram at the last minute often panic and fail. The same logic applies to career growth: the skills we sharpen through daily practice quietly prepare us for opportunities we cannot yet foresee.

Therefore, instead of worrying about an uncertain future, we should seize the day and focus on what we can control right now. If each of us does our best today, tomorrow will take care of itself. The most reliable preparation is always the honest effort we make in the present.
modelTranslation: "今天全力以赴就是对明天最好的准备"这句格言提醒我们一个朴素而深刻的道理：我们的未来并非仅靠焦虑的空想筑成，而是靠此刻投入的具体努力。在我看来，今天竭尽全力，正是我们为更美好的明天打下坚实地基的方式。
这一道理几乎在每个领域都成立。以备考为例。一个每天都复习一点、做题背单词的学生，会逐渐积累起在考试日得到回报的知识。相反，那些沉溺于拖延、到最后一刻才临时抱佛脚的人，往往会慌乱失利。同样的逻辑也适用于职业成长：我们通过日常练习磨砺的技能，会悄悄为那些我们尚无法预见的机会做好准备。
因此，与其忧虑不确定的未来，不如抓住今天、专注于此刻我们能掌控的事。只要我们每个人都过好今天，明天自会水到渠成。最可靠的准备，永远是我们在当下付出的诚实努力。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜释义加表态定调：。首段用 "The saying ... reminds us of a simple yet profound truth" 转述格言含义，再以 "In my view, giving our best today is precisely how we lay a solid foundation" 亮明赞同立场，落实了 outline 第一段『转述格言并亮明立场』的功能。

第 2 段｜原理加正反例落地：。主体段主题句 "This idea holds true in almost every field" 亮分论点，随后用备考的正例与 "In contrast, those who indulge in procrastination and cram at the last minute often panic and fail" 的反例形成对比，再以 "The same logic applies to career growth" 延伸，兑现了第二段『原理加正反例论证中心』的功能，把抽象格言写实。

第 3 段｜结论加号召收尾：。尾段以 "Therefore, instead of worrying about an uncertain future, we should seize the day" 推出结论并重申立场，再用 "If each of us does our best today, tomorrow will take care of itself" 发出行动号召、回扣格言，完成第三段『重申立场并发出行动号召』的功能，首尾照应。
prompts.paperTitle: 2020 年 7 月六级翻译与写作第 1 套

prompts.label: Part I · 写作
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the saying “Beauty of the soul is the essential beauty.” You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the saying “Beauty of the soul is the essential beauty.” You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
outline: 第 1 段｜释义格言并表态：用自己的话解释 Beauty of the soul is the essential beauty 的含义，并明确表示赞同，抛出中心论点。
第 2 段｜让步转折加例证论证：先承认外貌之美的吸引力，再转折强调其短暂；以对比与具体人物例证论证内在品德才持久、才是本质。
第 3 段｜重申升华并呼吁：回扣中心论点，指出应修养心灵而非执着外表，收束全文。
points: 先承认外貌吸引力：让步：漂亮的外表确实赏心悦目、能赢得第一眼的好感。先承认它，论证才显得公允而不偏激，也为下一步转折蓄力。
外在短暂内在持久：转折与对比：容貌会随岁月褪去，而善良、真诚、坚韧这类内在品德历久弥新——这是支撑『本质』二字的主论据。
以奉献者为例挖内心：举例：用一位彻夜工作的护士等具体人物，重点不是她的外表，而是她的善良、耐心与奉献如何打动人、被人记住，把『心灵之美如何体现』落到实处，避免空喊。
facts: 核心任务｜论证心灵美才是本质美：本题的核心任务是：围绕格言 Beauty of the soul is the essential beauty（心灵之美才是本质之美），先用自己的话点明对它的理解，再表明赞同立场，并用论证支撑。要写的不是『美的定义大全』，而是钉死一个中心——内在品德胜过外在容貌，且这一点是本质。凡是偏去大谈外貌重要、或只翻译格言不评论，都算没接住任务。
读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式书面语：本题是纯议论大作文，没有具体收信对象，也不需要署名。默认读者是阅卷老师，语域取正式书面语：不用缩写口语（如 gonna、kids），多用完整主从句，观点表达客观有据即可，无需加称呼语或落款。
中心立意｜内在品德才是持久本质之美：本篇中心论点一句话：外貌之美只是表象且会消退，真正让人美且让人铭记的是心灵与品德，正如格言所言 Beauty of the soul is the essential beauty。全文所有段落都服务于这一句，不摇摆。
rubric: 内容切题｜紧扣心灵为本质：本题必须始终围绕 Beauty of the soul is the essential beauty 立论，赞同心灵美是本质；最易失分是通篇复述格言或跑去谈外在美的重要性，导致中心偏移。
结构连贯｜让步转折链要显：本题论证靠『让步加转折』推进，务必让 Admittedly / However / by contrast 显性出现，读者才看得清『先退一步再强调内在』的逻辑。
语言准确｜用准内在美相关词：本题宜准确使用 inner beauty、virtue、transient、character that endures 等表达，并善用强调句 It is ... that；避免 beautiful、good 反复重复导致语言单调。
字数格式｜卡住150到200的硬线：本题硬性要求 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，低于下限或超过上限都失分；三段议论、无需称呼落款，保持格式干净即可。
pitfalls: 只抒情不论证：反面：『Beauty of the soul is so important. It is really beautiful. We all love a beautiful soul. Soul is more beautiful than face.』——全是空喊。改成：先释义『内在品德胜过外表』，再给理由『外貌会褪去而品德长存』，并举一个人物说明其心灵之美如何动人。
堆名人不挖品质：反面：『Lei Feng was famous. Einstein was a genius. Many great people are beautiful in soul.』——只堆名字。改成：聚焦一人，如一位护士，写她的 kindness and devotion 如何比外表更打动人、被人铭记，让例子真正支撑『心灵为本质』。

让步过度跑偏：反面：『Appearance is very important. A good face helps you get jobs and friends. Looks matter a lot in life.』——一整段捧外貌，偏离中心。改成：『Admittedly, an attractive appearance is pleasing; however, such charm is transient, while inner beauty endures.』一句认可即转折。
model: The saying "Beauty of the soul is the essential beauty" reminds us that what truly makes a person beautiful is not a pretty face but a noble heart. I fully agree: physical looks may catch the eye, yet it is inner virtue that gives a person lasting worth.

Admittedly, an attractive appearance is pleasing and can win instant admiration. However, such charm is transient; wrinkles come and youth fades. Inner beauty, by contrast, endures. Consider a nurse who works tirelessly through the night: her kindness, patience and devotion move us far more deeply than any fashion model's face. It is her character, not her looks, that we remember and respect. History, too, honours people not for how they looked but for the goodness they showed.

In conclusion, while outward beauty may fade with time, the beauty of a kind and honest soul only grows brighter. We should therefore cultivate our character rather than obsess over our looks, for it is the soul that makes us truly beautiful.
modelTranslation: 格言『心灵之美才是本质之美』提醒我们，真正使一个人美丽的不是一张漂亮的脸，而是一颗高尚的心。我完全赞同：外貌或许能吸引眼球，但真正赋予一个人持久价值的，是内在的品德。
诚然，动人的外表令人愉悦，能赢得一时的赞赏。然而，这种魅力是短暂的；皱纹会爬上来，青春会消逝。相比之下，内在之美却历久弥新。想想一位彻夜辛勤工作的护士：她的善良、耐心与奉献，远比任何时装模特的容颜更能打动我们。被我们铭记与尊敬的，是她的品格，而非她的外表。历史同样如此，它铭记人们不是因为他们长得如何，而是因为他们展现出的善良。
总之，外在之美会随时间褪去，而一颗善良真诚的心灵之美只会愈发闪耀。因此，我们应当修养自己的品德，而不是执着于外表，因为正是心灵使我们真正美丽。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜释义加表态一次交清：。首段落实『释义加表态开篇』：开头 The saying ... reminds us that what truly makes a person beautiful is not a pretty face but a noble heart 用『不是A而是B』把格言 Beauty of the soul is the essential beauty 说成人话，随即 I fully agree 表态并用 yet it is inner virtue that gives a person lasting worth 抛出中心论点。

第 2 段｜让步转折加护士例落地：。主体段落实『让步转折加实例论证』：Admittedly ... However, such charm is transient 先让步再转折，Inner beauty, by contrast, endures 完成对比；护士的 kindness, patience and devotion 与强调句 It is her character, not her looks, that we remember 把『心灵之美如何体现』挖实，避免了堆名人的空洞。

第 3 段｜while回扣加呼吁升华：。尾段落实『回扣主旨并升华』：In conclusion, while outward beauty may fade ... only grows brighter 用 while 把对比再压一遍回扣中心，We should therefore cultivate our character rather than obsess over our looks 升华到行动呼吁，落点收在心灵使人真正美丽。

prompts.label: Part I · 写作
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the saying “What is worth doing is worth doing well ”, You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the saying “What is worth doing is worth doing well ”, You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
outline: 第 1 段｜释义并亮明立场：用一两句解释 What is worth doing is worth doing well 的含义（重点在‘做好’），并明确表态赞同，抛出中心论点。
第 2 段｜分论点一加个人事例：主题句：做好成就个人成长；再配一个具体事例（如同学反复打磨论文）支撑。
第 3 段｜分论点二加社会事例：主题句：精益求精推动社会进步；再配工程师/工匠 spare no effort 的事例支撑。
第 4 段｜回扣格言收束升华：呼应格言、落到‘作为青年学生’的自身态度，做到首尾呼应。
points: 做好成就个人成长：分论点一（对个人）：把每件值得做的事做到位，是磨练能力、积累底气最可靠的途径。可配学习/写论文这类考生熟悉的事例。
精益求精推动社会进步：分论点二（对社会）：工程师、工匠对产品 spare no effort 的打磨，才有可靠的桥梁、手机、药品，社会因此进步。用工匠精神类事例。
facts: 核心任务｜赞同并论证这句格言：本题要求 write an essay on the saying，评论对象是 What is worth doing is worth doing well。任务不是讲故事、也不是单纯翻译，而是‘评论+表态’：用一两句把格言含义讲透（核心是‘做就要做好、精益求精’，而不是‘要不要去做’），亮明你赞同的立场，再用理由和事例把立场撑起来。
读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式书面语：本题是纯议论大作文，没有具体收信人，因此不用称呼、不用署名，通篇用面向阅卷人的正式书面语即可：多用完整长句、正式词汇（如 pursue excellence、be devoted to），避免 gonna、a lot of 这类口语，也不要出现‘I think I think’式的随意重复。
中心立意｜凡值得做的事都应追求做好：中心论点：我完全赞同 What is worth doing is worth doing well —— 一旦认定一件事值得投入，就该追求卓越、精益求精，而不是敷衍了事。注意落点是‘做好’，不是‘做不做’。
rubric: 内容切题｜紧扣做好而非做不做：本题最易跑题的地方是把 What is worth doing is worth doing well 写成‘要不要去做’或泛谈‘坚持’。达标要点：每段都要指向‘把事做好、精益求精’，并有清晰的赞同立场。
结构连贯｜四段清晰首尾呼应：本题达标要点：四段各司其职、用递进词衔接，结尾一句回扣格言，避免通篇一段到底或段落之间跳接无逻辑。
语言准确｜用准做好类高级表达：本题达标要点：围绕‘做好’的高级表达要用对（pursue excellence、strive for perfection、spare no effort），并做到句式长短结合，避免通篇简单句。
字数格式｜落在规定词数区间：本题硬性要求 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，低于下限或超过上限都直接扣分；无收信人、无署名，格式上就是标准议论短文，不要加称呼落款。
pitfalls: 跑题成要不要做事：反面示例："Everyone should keep doing things and never give up, because persistence is the key to success."（通篇在谈‘坚持去做’，完全没碰‘做好’）。改法："Once we decide a task is worth doing, we should not stop at finishing it but push ourselves to do it well."（把落点拉回‘做好’）。

抽象说理无例证：反面示例："Doing things well is very important and beneficial. It can help us a lot and make us better."（只有空泛判断）。改法："Take my roommate, who rewrote his thesis five times and finally won an honour—his care for detail became a real skill."（补上具体事例）。

只复述格言无立场：反面示例："The saying means that if a thing is worth doing, then it is worth doing well. This is what the proverb tells us."（原地打转、没有观点）。改法："The proverb reminds us to pursue excellence, and I firmly agree that anything worth our effort deserves to be done well."（解释后立刻表态）。
model: The proverb "What is worth doing is worth doing well" carries a simple yet profound message: once we decide that something is worth our effort, we should pursue excellence rather than settle for a careless, half-finished job. I firmly agree with this view.

To begin with, doing things well is the surest path to personal growth. When a student is devoted to a task and strives for perfection, every detail he polishes sharpens his own ability. Take my roommate, who rewrote his graduation thesis five times; the effort not only earned him an honour but also trained the patience he now relies on at work.

Furthermore, the spirit of doing well drives society forward. Great engineers and craftsmen who spare no effort to refine their products give us the reliable bridges, phones and medicines we depend on every day. Had they been content with a rough result, progress would slow and quality would collapse.

In conclusion, whatever is worth our time deserves our very best. As young students, we should abandon the get-it-done-quickly attitude and devote ourselves to every task, big or small, until it is truly done well.
modelTranslation: “值得做的事就值得做好”这句格言传递着一个简单却深刻的道理：一旦我们认定某件事值得投入，就应当追求卓越，而不是敷衍了事、半途而废。我完全赞同这一观点。
首先，把事情做好是个人成长最可靠的途径。当一个学生全身心投入一项任务、力求完美时，他打磨的每一个细节都在磨练自己的能力。就拿我的室友来说，他把毕业论文重写了五遍；这份努力不仅为他赢得了荣誉，也磨练出他如今在工作中所倚重的耐心。
其次，精益求精的精神推动社会前进。那些不遗余力打磨产品的杰出工程师和工匠，为我们带来了每天赖以依靠的可靠桥梁、手机与药品。倘若他们满足于粗糙的结果，进步就会放缓，质量也会崩塌。
总之，凡是值得我们投入时间的事，都值得我们全力以赴。作为青年学生，我们应当摒弃‘草草了事’的心态，全身心投入每一件事，无论大小，直到真正把它做好。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜释义加表态起笔：。用 "carries a simple yet profound message" 把格言含义讲透，点出落点是 pursue excellence rather than settle for a careless job；再以 "I firmly agree with this view" 一句亮明立场，落实了第一段‘释义并亮明立场’的功能。
第 2 段｜主题句加室友事例：。"To begin with, doing things well is the surest path to personal growth" 是主题句，随后用室友重写论文五遍的具体事例支撑，套用了‘论点句加个人事例’的四步结构。
第 3 段｜换社会角度加反面假设：。"Furthermore" 递进换到社会角度，用工程师、工匠 spare no effort 的事例，并以 "Had they been content with a rough result" 的反面假设收紧，落实了‘论点句加社会事例’。
第 4 段｜呼应格言落到学生：。"In conclusion, whatever is worth our time deserves our very best" 呼应格言、总收全文，再以 "As young students, we should abandon the get-it-done-quickly attitude" 落到自身态度，做到首尾呼应。
prompts.paperTitle: 2020 年 9 月六级翻译与写作第 2 套

prompts.label: Part I · 写作
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the saying “Wealth of the mind is the only true wealth.” You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the saying “Wealth of the mind is the only true wealth.” You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
outline: 第 1 段｜释义格言并亮明立场：开篇复述并解读 Wealth of the mind is the only true wealth 的含义，随即表明本文同意这一立场。
第 2 段｜对比论证加举例：主体段：以‘物质易逝 vs 精神恒久’的对比作为核心论证，配一个具体人物例证支撑中心论点。
第 3 段｜重申立场并升华：结尾承认物质的作用后重申精神财富才是真财富，升华为对读者的呼吁。
points: 先释义再表态：开篇解读格言：‘心灵的财富’指知识、智慧、道德品格等精神层面的富有，与金钱、房产等物质财富相对；随即亮明本文同意该立场。为后文论证定调。
对比论证物质易逝精神恒久：主体段用对比：物质财富脆弱易逝(可因投资失败、火灾、经济危机一夜蒸发)，而精神财富恒久且只会增长；再举一个具体人物例子(如曼德拉)证明精神力量无人能夺。这一点直接呼应 the only true wealth 中‘唯一’的分量。
重申并升华为行动：结尾重申立场：金钱让生活舒适，但真正丰盈并长存的是心灵的财富；升华为呼吁——应致力于滋养心灵，这是任何厄运都夺不走的宝藏。
facts: 核心任务｜评论一句格言并表态：本题要写一篇短议论文，围绕 Wealth of the mind is the only true wealth 这句格言，先解读它的含义，再亮出自己的立场并论证。核心不是复述格言，而是‘你怎么看、为什么’——把‘心灵的财富才是唯一真正的财富’这一命题立场说清并撑起来。
读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式书面语：本题无具体收信人、无情境身份，属纯议论大作文，因此不需要称呼与署名。语域定位为面向阅卷人的正式书面英语：避免口语缩略与网络用语，用完整句、正式连接词，观点明确、论证有条理即可。
中心立意｜精神财富才是唯一真财富：本篇中心论点：认同 Wealth of the mind is the only true wealth——知识、智慧与品格这类精神财富，比金钱物质更持久、更能增值，才配称真正的财富。全文围绕这一表态展开，立场不摇摆。
rubric: 内容切题｜评论而非复述格言：本题要求 write an essay on the saying，达标要点是‘解读+表态+论证’三样都在，最易失分是只翻译复述格言、不展开自己的评论，导致内容空洞。
结构连贯｜三段各司其职加信号词：本题达标要点是三段分别承担‘释义表态—对比举例—重申升华’，并用 by contrast、Therefore 等过渡词串起；易失分是通篇一段或段落功能混杂。
语言准确｜用准精神财富主题词：本题可用 intellectual/spiritual wealth、enrich the mind、everlasting、fleeting 等主题词提分，但要用对搭配；易失分是硬塞不会用的大词造成搭配错误。
字数格式｜落在硬性区间内：本题硬约束是 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，达标要点是既不写得过短也不严重超字；三段式、无信件格式，注意分段。
pitfalls: 只复述格言不论证：反面示例：‘This saying means the wealth of the mind is the true wealth. The mind is very important. Wealth of the mind is really the only true wealth.’——通篇绕圈复述格言。改法：‘Knowledge and character are true wealth because, unlike money, they cannot be lost and keep growing throughout life.’给出理由。

泛谈重要缺例证：反面示例：‘Spiritual wealth is very important and everyone needs it because it is meaningful and precious.’——空泛无支撑。改法：加实例，如‘Consider Nelson Mandela, who lost every possession in prison yet led a nation with the strength of his mind.’

立场摇摆两边倒：反面示例：‘Spiritual wealth is the only true wealth. But actually money is the most important thing in life and we cannot live without it.’——自相矛盾。改法：‘While money makes life comfortable, it is the wealth of the mind that truly endures.’先让步再重申立场。
model: The saying "Wealth of the mind is the only true wealth" reminds us that knowledge, wisdom and moral character matter far more than money or property. In my view, this statement captures a profound truth: only the riches we build within ourselves can be called genuine wealth.

Material possessions, however dazzling, are fragile and fleeting. A fortune can be lost to a bad investment, a fire or an economic crisis overnight, leaving its owner with nothing. The wealth of the mind, by contrast, is everlasting and can only grow. Consider Nelson Mandela, who spent twenty-seven years in prison stripped of every material comfort; yet his intellectual and spiritual strength enabled him to lead a nation and inspire the world. No thief could ever steal what he carried in his mind.

Therefore, while money certainly makes life more comfortable, it is the wealth of the mind that truly enriches and endures. We should devote ourselves to cultivating our minds, for that alone is a treasure no misfortune can take away.
modelTranslation: “心灵的财富才是唯一真正的财富”这句格言提醒我们：知识、智慧和道德品格远比金钱或房产重要得多。在我看来，这句话道出了一个深刻的真理——唯有我们在自身内在积累起来的财富，才配称真正的财富。
物质财产无论多么耀眼，都脆弱而短暂。一笔财富可能因一次失败的投资、一场火灾或一次经济危机在一夜之间化为乌有，令其主人一无所有。相比之下，心灵的财富恒久长存，且只会增长。想想纳尔逊·曼德拉，他在狱中度过了二十七年，被剥夺了一切物质享受；然而他在智识与精神上的力量使他得以领导一个国家、激励整个世界。没有任何窃贼能偷走他藏于心中的东西。
因此，尽管金钱确实让生活更舒适，但真正令人丰盈并能长存的，是心灵的财富。我们应当致力于滋养自己的心灵，因为唯有那才是任何厄运都无法夺走的宝藏。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜释义加表态落地：。首段用 The saying "…" reminds us that… 把格言译成自己的话(knowledge, wisdom and moral character)，再用 In my view… captures a profound truth 亮明立场，正是‘释义加表态’两步，让阅卷人第一眼看到你读懂并有观点。

第 2 段｜对比加举例落地：。本段先讲 Material possessions… are fragile and fleeting，再用 by contrast 转到 The wealth of the mind… everlasting，成对对比；随后 Consider Nelson Mandela… 给出具体例证，末句 No thief could ever steal… 回扣中心，四步齐全，是全文得分主战场。
第 3 段｜重申再升华落地：。结尾 while money certainly makes life more comfortable 先让步承认物质，再用主句重申 it is the wealth of the mind that truly enriches；末句 We should devote ourselves to… 升华为呼吁，立场稳而不极端。
prompts.paperTitle: 2020 年 9 月六级翻译与写作第 3 套

prompts.label: Part I · 写作
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on why students should be encouraged to develop creativity.You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on why students should be encouraged to develop creativity.You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
outline: 第 1 段｜亮明立场：一句点题背景铺垫，紧接一句明确表态：支持积极鼓励学生发展创造力。
第 2 段｜两理由论证：并列展开两个理由——激发学习兴趣、提升解决问题能力，各配解释与例证。
第 3 段｜重申升华：重申'鼓励创造力是必需而非奢侈'，升华到个人成长与未来意义。
points: 激发学习兴趣：理由一：创造力让学习更投入——当学生能自己想象、设计解决方案而不是死记答案时，会产生真正的好奇心和学习热情。
提升解决问题能力：理由二：创造力磨练解决问题的能力——习惯探索不同思路的人能灵活应对新挑战，而这正是未来职场所需要的，可用'用人单位更青睐能提出原创设计的人'这个场景落地。
facts: 核心任务｜论证'为何鼓励'：任务是就一个给定话题写议论文：write an essay on why students should be encouraged to develop creativity。题眼是 why——要回答的是'为什么应当鼓励'（原因/价值），不是'如何培养'（方法/对策）。这一步读错，整篇就跑题。
读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式书面语：本题是纯议论大作文，没有具体收信人，也没有署名要求。因此用面向阅卷人的正式书面语即可：不写称呼和落款，避免缩写（don't）、口语和俚语，通篇保持克制的立场表达。
中心立意｜鼓励创造力很有必要：中心论点：学生应当被积极鼓励去发展创造力，因为它既利于个人成长、也利于社会。全篇都在回答 why students should be encouraged to develop creativity，始终围绕'原因/价值'展开。
rubric: 内容切题｜紧扣why别写how：本题必须围绕 why students should be encouraged to develop creativity 的 why 展开；最易失分是写成'怎么培养创造力'的对策文，一旦出现 how to、schools should provide 之类的方法罗列，就要警惕跑题。
结构连贯｜三段清晰＋过渡词：本题应三段分明、每个理由一句主题句领起，用 First、Moreover、In conclusion 串接；最忌把理由揉成一大段、缺少首尾立场句。
语言准确｜创造力同义替换：本题围绕 creativity，可用 innovation、imagination、original thinking 交替，避免通篇 creativity 复读；句式上让观点句用复合句、例证句落到具体名词，读起来才有层次。
字数格式｜卡区间中段最稳：本题有硬性上下限 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，写太少论证不足、写太多易超时越界；三段布局、每段饱满即可自然落在区间内。
pitfalls: 写成对策文：反面示例：'To develop creativity, schools should offer more art classes and teachers should give students more freedom.'——这是在答'怎么培养'，跑题。改成答 why：'Creativity should be encouraged because it makes learning more engaging and prepares students for future challenges.'

只喊口号不展开：反面示例：'Creativity is very important. It is good for students. Everyone needs creativity.'——空喊无支撑。改成：'Creativity makes learning engaging, because students who design their own solutions study with real curiosity instead of memorizing answers.'
理由揉成一大段：反面示例：把立场、两个理由、结论全塞进不分段的一长段，读者找不到逻辑节点。改成：立场、论证、重申各自独立成段，段首用 First、Moreover、In conclusion 标出层次。
model: In an age driven by innovation, the ability to think in original ways has never been more valuable. Therefore, I firmly believe that students should be actively encouraged to develop their creativity, for it benefits both their growth and society at large.

First, creativity makes learning far more engaging. When students are free to imagine and design their own solutions, rather than merely memorizing answers, they become genuinely curious and study with real enthusiasm. Moreover, creativity sharpens the ability to solve problems. A learner who is used to exploring different approaches can adapt flexibly to new challenges, which is exactly what future workplaces demand. For instance, many employers today value an engineer who can propose an original design over one who only follows fixed rules.

In conclusion, encouraging creativity is far from a luxury; it is a necessity. By nurturing imagination and original thinking, schools equip students to enrich their own lives and to meet the uncertain demands of tomorrow.
modelTranslation: 在一个由创新驱动的时代，以原创方式思考的能力从未像今天这样宝贵。因此，我坚定地认为，应当积极鼓励学生发展创造力，因为它既有益于他们自身的成长，也有益于整个社会。
首先，创造力让学习变得有趣得多。当学生可以自由地去想象、去设计自己的解决方案，而不是单纯地背诵答案时，他们会真正产生好奇心，并带着热情去学习。此外，创造力还能磨练解决问题的能力。一个习惯于探索不同思路的学习者，能够灵活地应对新挑战，而这恰恰是未来职场所需要的。举例来说，如今许多雇主更看重一个能提出原创设计的工程师，而不是一个只会照章办事的人。
总之，鼓励创造力绝非一种奢侈，而是一种必需。通过培育想象力与原创思考，学校才能让学生既丰富自己的人生，又足以应对未来那些不确定的挑战。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜立场段落地：。开头 'In an age driven by innovation... has never been more valuable' 用点题背景句铺垫；随后 'I firmly believe that students should be actively encouraged to develop their creativity' 明确表态，落实了'立场段先亮态度'的先景后态。

第 2 段｜三连论证落地：。'First, creativity makes learning far more engaging' 是观点句，后接一句解释；'Moreover, creativity sharpens the ability to solve problems' 引出第二个理由；'For instance, many employers today value an engineer who can propose an original design' 用事例把理由说实，正是'观点+解释+例证三连'。
第 3 段｜收束升华落地：。'encouraging creativity is far from a luxury; it is a necessity' 换个说法重申中心立场；'schools equip students to... meet the uncertain demands of tomorrow' 升华到未来意义，落实'重申升华'。
prompts.paperTitle: 2020 年 12 月六级翻译与写作第 1 套

prompts.label: Part I · 写作
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on why students should be encouraged to effective communication skills. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on why students should be encouraged to effective communication skills. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
outline: 第 1 段｜点题亮立场：首段：一句话点出'有效沟通对学生很重要'并表态，回应 why students should be encouraged to effective communication skills，给全文定调。
第 2 段｜分层论证：主体段：用 First / Moreover / In addition 领起三条并列理由（助学业、强求职、润人际），每条配一句具体说明或例子。
第 3 段｜重申升华：尾段：概括三条理由、重申立场，并呼吁学校创造更多锻炼沟通的机会，收束全文。
points: 助学业协作：理由一：沟通能力直接提升学习效率——能在小组项目里清楚表达疑问、交换观点的学生，知识吸收得更快。这是'学业'场景的落点。
强求职竞争力：理由二：沟通能力是求职硬通货——面试中能把想法讲得有条理的人，比只会罗列资历的人更占优势。这是'求职'场景的落点。
润人际情感：理由三：沟通能力丰富人际关系——帮助学生表达情绪、以共情化解冲突，让校园生活更健康。这是'生活情感'场景的落点。
facts: 核心任务｜论证沟通能力为何该被鼓励：本题要写一篇议论文，全程回答一个问题：why students should be encouraged to effective communication skills。落到笔下就是——摆出'学生具备有效沟通能力很重要'这个立场，再用理由和例子把'为什么重要'讲透，不写方法、不写现状。
读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式书面语：本题是纯主题论说、没有具体收信人，write an essay 指向一篇标准议论文。因此按'面向阅卷人的正式书面语'来写即可：用第三人称与客观口吻，避免 you know、gonna 这类口语和缩写，也不需要称呼语或署名。
中心立意｜沟通能力是学生的核心竞争力：中心立场：有效沟通能力不是可有可无的软技能，而是塑造学生学业与职业前景的核心能力，因此学校应积极鼓励学生培养它。这一句正面回应 why students should be encouraged to effective communication skills。
rubric: 内容切题｜紧扣为何重要：本题达标关键是全程围绕 why students should be encouraged to effective communication skills 给理由；最易失分是写成如何提升沟通技巧的方法清单，或脱离'学生'泛谈沟通。
结构连贯｜三段并列清晰：本题达标要点是三段分明、主体段三条理由用连接词分点、尾段重申首段立场；易失分是通篇不分段或理由之间无过渡。
语言准确｜善用沟通搭配：本题可用 express ideas、articulate thoughts、resolve conflicts 等与 communication 相关的地道搭配提升表达；易失分是中式直译如 'communication is very important' 反复堆砌。
字数格式｜卡准上下限：本题硬约束是 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，低于 150 或超过 200 都扣分；无需称呼与署名，纯议论文正文即可。
pitfalls: 只喊重要：反面：'Communication is very important. It is important for students. So students should learn it because it is useful.' 空转无支撑。修正：'Communication matters because, in group projects, students who clearly express doubts absorb knowledge far more efficiently.' 用具体场景把'为什么重要'讲实。

写成怎么做：反面：'To improve communication, students should join clubs, read more books and practice speaking every day.' 这是回答 how，偏离任务。修正：'Good communication deserves encouragement because it helps students collaborate in class and stand out in future interviews.' 回到'为什么该被鼓励'。

重复充数：反面：结尾写 'In conclusion, communication is important. Communication is really important. Students must know communication is important.' 三句同义重复注水。修正：'In conclusion, effective communication benefits students in study, career and daily life alike, so schools should offer more debates and presentations.' 概括加呼吁，句句有新信息。
model: Effective communication is far more than a soft skill; it is a core competence that shapes a student's academic success and professional future. For this reason, schools and teachers should actively encourage students to develop this valuable ability from an early stage.

There are several compelling reasons for this. First, strong communication skills facilitate learning. When students can clearly express doubts and exchange ideas in group projects, knowledge is absorbed far more efficiently. Moreover, these skills sharpen employability. In job interviews, an applicant who articulates thoughts logically leaves a stronger impression than one who merely lists qualifications. In addition, good communication enriches personal relationships, helping students voice their emotions and resolve conflicts with empathy. Such emotional connection is essential for a healthy campus life.

In conclusion, effective communication benefits students in study, career and daily life alike. Schools should therefore create more opportunities—debates, presentations and teamwork—so that every student can grow into a confident and articulate communicator.
modelTranslation: 有效沟通远不只是一项软技能，它是一种塑造学生学业成功与职业前景的核心能力。正因如此，学校和老师应当积极鼓励学生尽早培养这一宝贵能力。
这样做有几条有力的理由。首先，扎实的沟通能力有助于学习。当学生能在小组项目中清楚地表达疑问、交换想法时，知识的吸收会高效得多。其次，这些能力能增强就业竞争力。在面试中，一个能有条理地表达想法的应聘者，比只会罗列资历的人给人留下更深的印象。此外，良好的沟通能丰富人际关系，帮助学生表达情绪、以共情化解冲突。这种情感上的联结对健康的校园生活至关重要。
总之，有效沟通让学生在学业、职业和日常生活中同样受益。因此学校应当创造更多机会——辩论、演讲和团队合作——让每一个学生都能成长为自信而善于表达的沟通者。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜拔高加表态：。本段落实'先拔高再表态'：首句 'Effective communication is far more than a soft skill; it is a core competence...' 把主题拔高定性，次句 'For this reason, schools and teachers should actively encourage students to develop this valuable ability' 顺势亮立场，直接回应 why students should be encouraged to effective communication skills，完成首段点题。

第 2 段｜三理由各带例：。本段用 'There are several compelling reasons for this' 总起，再以 First / Moreover / In addition 领起三条理由，每条都配了具体场景：group projects、job interviews、resolve conflicts with empathy，把'理由句+例子'的方法落到实处，避免空喊。

第 3 段｜收束再呼吁：。本段用 'In conclusion, effective communication benefits students in study, career and daily life alike' 把三条理由压缩重申，与首段呼应；再以 'Schools should therefore create more opportunities—debates, presentations and teamwork' 给出可操作呼吁，实现'收束加呼吁'。

prompts.label: Part I · 写作
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on why students should be encouraged to develop the ability to meet challenges. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on why students should be encouraged to develop the ability to meet challenges. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
outline: 第 1 段｜背景切入＋亮明立场：用一句时代/校园背景引入话题，随即直接表态：应当鼓励学生培养迎接挑战的能力，回应 why students should be encouraged to develop the ability to meet challenges。
第 2 段｜并列理由＋微例论证：主体段，用连接词串起 2-3 个理由（潜能、抗挫与解决问题、成长），每条配一句解释或一个大学生场景的小例子。
第 3 段｜重申立场＋收尾呼吁：归纳全文因果，重申应鼓励这种能力，并轻点一句做法/呼吁收束。
points: 挑战激发被埋没的潜能：第一条理由：直面挑战会逼学生把平时用不到的潜力挖出来。可用大学生熟悉的场景——一个新生硬着头皮接下一个难做的课题，往往发现自己原来能行。
挑战锤炼抗挫与解决问题能力：第二条理由：每一次应对挑战都在磨练抗挫力和解决问题的本领。可举竞赛失利、实习受挫这类微例——课本给不了的经验，恰恰在闯关中学到。
为未来激烈竞争与终身成长做准备：第三条理由（收尾拔高用）：迎挑战的能力是为将来激烈的求职竞争与终身成长打底，让学生成为不轻易放弃的独立思考者。
facts: 核心任务｜论证为何该鼓励学生练迎挑战能力：题目要求 write an essay on why students should be encouraged to develop the ability to meet challenges，核心任务是回答 why——论证『为什么应当鼓励学生培养迎接挑战的能力』这件事的重要性/原因，而不是讲『怎么培养』。全文都在回答 why students should be encouraged to develop the ability to meet challenges 这一个问题。
读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式书面语：本题是一篇没有具体收信人的议论短文，无需称呼与署名，只要用面向阅卷人的正式书面语即可：不用缩写口语（don't、gonna），多用完整句和书面词，态度客观说理。语域这一关在议论文里不像应用文那样致命，一句话带过、别强行加戏。
中心立意｜应大力鼓励学生练就迎挑战的能力：中心立场一句话钉死：学生理应被鼓励去培养迎接挑战的能力，因为这种能力对其潜能、抗挫与未来发展至关重要。这正面回应了 why students should be encouraged to develop the ability to meet challenges，全篇围绕这一个 why 展开。
rubric: 内容切题｜全篇必须答why不写how：本题达标关键是全文都在论证 why students should be encouraged to develop the ability to meet challenges，即重要性/原因；最易失分处是写成『如何培养挑战能力』的做法清单，那样即便语言再好也偏题。
结构连贯｜理由分层且用连接词串联：本题达标要点是 2-3 个理由层次分明、用因果与递进词串起；最易失分处是理由重复或并列不分主次、缺连接词，读起来像流水账。
语言准确｜书面词准确避免逐字直译：本题应多用 encounter、resilience、potential 等书面词，句式适度变化；最易失分处是把中文『培养能力』『面对挑战』逐字直译成生硬搭配，或全篇短句无变化。
字数格式｜落在150到200硬性区间内：本题要求 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，是硬性区间，写不足下限或大幅超出上限都会失分；无需称呼署名，正常分段即可。
pitfalls: 写成如何培养的做法清单：反面示例：To develop this ability, students should get up early, make detailed plans and practice every day.（这是在教怎么做，跑题）。改成对准 why：Because this ability enables students to unlock their potential, it deserves to be actively encouraged.

空喊挑战很重要却无理由：反面示例：Challenges are very important. Everyone should meet challenges. Challenges make us strong.（三句都在重复口号，无理由无例子）。改成有支撑：Challenges matter because every setback in a competition teaches lessons that no textbook can offer.

中式直译培养面对挑战的怪句：反面示例：Students should cultivate the ability of facing to the difficult, so their body will become strong.（cultivate the ability of facing to、body strong 都是硬翻的错搭）。改成地道：Students should develop the ability to meet challenges so that they can grow more resilient.
model: In an era of rapid change, students inevitably encounter difficulties in their studies, career hunting and daily life. It is therefore of great importance that they be encouraged to develop the ability to meet challenges.

There are several convincing reasons why this ability deserves cultivation. To begin with, facing challenges pushes students to unlock their hidden potential. A first-year student who dares to tackle a tough research project, for instance, often discovers strengths he never knew he possessed. More importantly, meeting challenges sharpens one's resilience and problem-solving skills. Every setback in a competition or an internship teaches valuable lessons that no textbook can offer. As a result, such students grow into independent thinkers who refuse to give up easily.

In conclusion, since the ability to meet challenges prepares young people for fierce competition and lifelong growth, schools and families should spare no effort to foster it. Only by embracing challenges rather than avoiding them can students truly become masters of their own future.
modelTranslation: 在一个飞速变化的时代，学生在学业、求职和日常生活中不可避免地会遇到种种困难。因此，鼓励他们培养迎接挑战的能力就显得尤为重要。
这种能力值得培养，有几条令人信服的理由。首先，直面挑战会促使学生释放自身潜藏的潜能。举例来说，一个敢于接下高难度课题的大一新生，往往会发现自己身上从未察觉的实力。更重要的是，迎接挑战会磨砺人的抗挫能力与解决问题的本领。竞赛或实习中的每一次挫折，都会教给人课本无法给予的宝贵经验。因此，这样的学生会成长为不轻言放弃的独立思考者。
总之，既然迎接挑战的能力为年轻人应对激烈竞争与终身成长打下根基，学校与家庭就应不遗余力地去培养它。唯有拥抱挑战而非逃避挑战，学生才能真正成为自己未来的主人。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜背景一句随即表态：。首段用 In an era of rapid change 一句背景引入，紧接着 It is therefore of great importance that they be encouraged to develop the ability to meet challenges 直接亮明立场，落实了『背景引入句架』与『亮明立场句架』，一两句就完成表态，正面对准 why students should be encouraged to develop the ability to meet challenges。

第 2 段｜递进串两理由各配微例：。主体段用 To begin with … More importantly … 把『潜能』『抗挫与解决问题』两条理由分层串起，A first-year student … for instance 与 a competition or an internship 各给一个大学生场景微例，最后 As a result 小结回扣中心，落实了理由分层、举例过渡、因果小结三个句架。
第 3 段｜因果归纳后倒装呼吁：。尾段 In conclusion, since … 把前文理由归纳为一句因果并重申立场，末句 Only by embracing challenges … can students truly become masters of their own future 用倒装强调唯一途径收束，落实了归纳因果与唯一路径两个句架，形成首尾闭环。
